visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white tiered camisole over a grey long-sleeved shirt and light blue denim jeans, stands at an outdoor Korean street food stall. She holds a wooden skewer with a fish cake and takes a bite while looking at the camera. Behind her, large trays of fried food and spicy rice cakes sit under bright white fluorescent stall lights. (2) The woman picks up a paper cup from the counter and takes a sip. Her facial expression shifts from calm to one of sudden discomfort as she pulls the cup away quickly, her eyes widening. A red variety-style text appears on screen. She turns her head away from the counter, holding the hot liquid in her mouth. (3) She places the cup back on the stainless steel counter and looks at the camera, speaking while gesturing with her free hand. She bends over slightly to adjust something on the lower shelf of the stall before standing back up and addressing the camera with a playful, pained expression. The background shows a bustling night market with pedestrians and shop signs.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous short-form vlog capturing a relatable 'fail' moment. The creator intends to document a pleasant food-tasting experience but instead focuses on the funny and painful reaction of burning her mouth on extremely hot soup and fish cakes at a Korean night market.
